rows.title: Muslim athan
rows.cover_letter: You need an Alexa skill that automatically plays the athan five times a day based on the user’s location, without any manual prompts. I have previously proposed a Muslim athan Alexa solution [faf01d10d22c6438]. My approach starts with a two‑day sprint to set up a Lambda function that obtains the device’s geolocation (using Alexa’s device address API), queries a reliable prayer‑time service, and calculates the five daily prayer times. I will store high‑quality athan audio files in S3 and configure the skill’s AudioPlayer to stream them automatically. A scheduling layer will trigger playback at each calculated time, handling timezone and daylight‑saving adjustments by recomputing times daily. By day three we will deliver a working prototype that plays the athan for one prayer, and the following sprint will add the remaining four times, thorough testing on multiple Alexa devices, and full documentation of the source code and deployment scripts. I will provide daily updates and be ready to start immediately, ensuring the skill meets your timeline and quality expectations.
